facts.fact: PM-KISAN: eligible landholding farmer families get Rs 6,000 a year in three equal instalments by DBT
facts.quote: Under the Scheme, eligible landholding farmer families receive financial assistance of Rs.6,000 per year, transferred directly into their bank accounts in three equal instalments.
facts.note: The same PIB release (31 Jul 2026) is titled 'Cabinet approves continuation of the PM-KISAN Scheme from 2026-27 to 2030-31'.

facts.fact: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance): the farmer pays at most 2% premium for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for annual commercial or horticultural crops; the rest is subsidised
facts.quote: The maximum premium payable by the farmer will be 2% for the Kharif food and oilseed crops. For rabi food and oilseeds crop, it is 1.5% and for yearly commercial or horticultural crops it will be 5%.

facts.fact: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana: assured pension of Rs 3,000 a month for small and marginal farmers (up to 2 hectares) who join between ages 18 and 40
facts.quote: Eligibility For Small and Marginal Farmers Entry Age between 18 to 40 years Cultivable land up to 2 hectares as per land records of the concerned State/UT Features Assured pension of Rs. 3000/- month

behaviour: Handles the romanised Hindi (7.4.5) and replies in Hinglish/Hindi; gives a short list of Central farmer schemes (e.g. PM-KISAN, PMFBY, PM Kisan Maandhan) with their key benefit or criteria, each cited to the myScheme record or the Ministry/PIB page; links myScheme for the full list; no eligibility verdict.
fail_if: It lists State schemes as Central, gives amounts not on the cited source, or dumps a long uncited list.
summary: Added three core Central farmer schemes with their published benefit: PM-KISAN Rs 6,000/yr (PIB 31 Jul 2026, continued to 2030-31), PMFBY premium caps 2%/1.5%/5% (myScheme), PM-KMY Rs 3,000/month pension, entry age 18-40 (pmkmy.gov.in).
